notes.title: Version 1.06 is now Live for all users
notes.notes:
It's finally here! This update includes lots of "quality of life" changes, and several new features. You'll find a video below that explains it in a bit more details, as well as our Patch Notes posted below. But let's quickly go over some highlights...

First Person Mode
You can now view, and build your scenes from a first-person perspective! 

Refurbished UI!
Paint, build, and even the main menu screens all have undergone revamps that will make it easier to navigate. 

Fog of war!
The fog of war feature has returned, with some easier tools. 

[previewyoutube=ZNkzye57ePo;full][/previewyoutube]



Updates:

 Fog of war is back, with a few changes (Holding the ‘F’ key now brings up the FOW eraser)
 Holding ctrl and using the middle mouse will scale up or down the size of the fog of war eraser.
 Objects now rotate 90 degrees when in grid mode.
 The Game autosaves every 60 seconds.
 Delete has been changed (Hold the Delete key and click on the item to remove)
 The game now has credits in the main menu.
 The main menu got an overhaul (thanks to NoTheVarb)
  You can now paint on walls and foundations (Ctrl + Placing the items when placing walls use the cycle snapping mode for the best result)
 You can now paint on all objects with a slight delay (Ctrl + Placing the items )
 Added an fps counter in the RE logo at the top left.
 Graphics settings now save with each map.
 Workshop downloading now has a progress bar.
 Lighting menus got redesigned.
 The Tabletop menu now allows you to move any direction 1 tile at a time.
 The Tabletop menu now has a zoom slider.
 The Tabletop menu now has a Field of view slider.
 The Tabletop menu now has a home button.
 Audio mixes now save with maps.
 Intro movie added.
 Stone texture for painting now matches the stone foundations.
 2D & 3D paint now has images to represent the paint layer.
 Crystals now change colour.
 Eraser icon added to paint menu.
 3D sculpting and Paint menu has undergone an overhaul.
 foliage now switches on Grass
 blank material removed from 3D sculpting
 Added in Internal Stairs
 Added in Castle Walls
 Darkness Spell added.
 Added Animated Deer, Doe and a Fox.
 Added Dungeon Floor Torch
 Added mirror
 Multiplayer Ui Updated.



 
Bug Fixes:

 The lighting & weather system now saves and loads correctly.
 Rectangle selection mode got fixed, now only item fully enclosed will be selected 
 Walls now attach to the sides of each other without increasing the level.
 Roof pieces now rotate whilst holding shift and fit together a lot better.
 Fixed how the camera works. it should not be so violent anymore.
 Imported models and audio now copy to your save file so that they will transfer to the workshop.
 Imported assets no longer keep the pawns Collison
 Candles position glitch fixed
 The light menu now retains selected light colours
 The rectangle selection box no longer selects invisible items.
 Fixed lights that opened settings on left click instead of right
 Ceilings now snap to sloped roofs
 Removed the immortal Deer.
 Experimental features:
 First-person mode added to use the f10 key to toggle
 Procedural dungeons and forests have been added to the paint menu.
 Multiplayer is now live for those in the Patreon and beta testing groups.
 Multiplayer now has an invite system.
 Multiplayer has Voice chat.
 Num + key is Push to talk.


Known issues:

 Copy, paste, and transformations are not currently undoable.
 Fog of war does not save yet.
 Workshop maps' names must remain the same as in the game. If you wish to rename your map save a copy in-game with the new name then upload that file.
  



Patreon has also been restructured. 

Patreon tiers are now cheaper, with more tangible benefits. Patreon is how I keep this project running, and it even includes the online multiplayer, so I wanted a better way to show thanks to those that follow me there. Please check it out, and consider supporting this free software! 
https://www.patreon.com/RealmEngine

Thank you all for your support! Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.051 is now live for all players!
notes.notes:
Updates and fixes:

•	Re designed Builder window
•	Performance optimizations
•	added asset pack filters.
•	each pack is now collapsible.
•	rectangle selection Box added by using CTRL + Shift Left Mouse button drag
•	walls now snap to the sides of other walls.
•	added the ability to toggle the way snapping works (hover, cycle)
•	re-designed roof pieces to align and snap better (can still be improved)
•	Miniature settings are back and working.
•	Lighting optimizations
•	Fixed up thumbnail capture for saving files & workshop (saves what is currently on screen as the thumbnail)
•	Ins button now toggles snapping mode from nearby to cycle
•	Audio now saves and loads 
•	Weather system and lighting now saves and loads
•	Fx layers now save and loads

Cycle Snapping Mode:
•	using the middle mouse wheel allows you to scroll through the connection points on the object you are currently hovering over

Nearby Snapping Mode:
•	will snap to the closest spot to your mouse (using the middle mouse scroll will rotate the object in the current snapped location)

Assets Updates & Dlc’s:
•	Added 115 Cave and caverns asset pack to the base game
•	Added 150 Tavern and kitchen assets to DLC for free as its 5GB of high-quality assets
•	a new Jungle ruins DLC with over 200 assets for $4.99 

Known issues:
•	undo only works with 3d terrain and 2d terrain placement and destruction
•	copy paste and transformations are not currently undoable
•	fog of war not visible
•	downloading from the workshop requires you to download it twice if you aren’t subscribed to that item already
